There are 230 customers, assuming every customer's meal contained at least two of the ingredients.

Let HC, HT and TC be the sets of customers whose meals contain both ham and cheese, both ham and tomato, and both tomato and cheese. Their sizes are 80, 90 and 100. Any two of these sets overlap exactly in the customers who had all three ingredients, so each pairwise intersection and the triple intersection has size 20.

Inclusion-exclusion gives:

|HC ∪ HT ∪ TC| = 80 + 90 + 100 − 20 − 20 − 20 + 20 = 230

As a check, the number with exactly two ingredients is (80 − 20) + (90 − 20) + (100 − 20) = 60 + 70 + 80 = 210. Adding the 20 with all three gives 230.

ANSWER: 230
